The color depth of the graphics mode in bits.
@returns The depth in bits.
@gap It is the depth of the buffers that [Graphics](Graphics) or [Graphics3D](Graphics3D) made: 24, 30, 32 or 64, and 32 if the depth that was asked for is none of these. See [Color depth](Color-Depth).
